name: SursaTech AI Advisor
description: SursaTech AI Advisor for an AI-native product engineering company in Kathmandu, Nepal, founded in 2017. Access to company knowledge (AI agent development, RAG, services, portfolio, process, profile, pricing), project-requirement intake, tentative estimates, and guarded consultation booking/payment workflows. Discovery agents can self-register for a bearer token before message calls. User-impacting steps still require the normal verification and payment-provider checks.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque bearer token returned by /api/a2a/register or /api/a2a/token, or minted out-of-band for known partners.

skills.name: Get company profile
skills.description: Return SursaTech's AI-native company overview, founding year, location, and contact details.

skills.name: Get services
skills.description: List SursaTech's AI agent development, RAG, AI-native product engineering, automation, and QA offerings.

skills.name: Get portfolio
skills.description: List representative SursaTech client projects and case studies.

skills.name: Get development process
skills.description: Describe how SursaTech runs discovery, build, and operations phases.

skills.name: Capture lead requirement
skills.description: Persist a structured project requirement from an inbound agent for human follow-up.

skills.name: Estimate project
skills.description: Return a tentative timeline and price band for a described project scope.

skills.name: Start consultation booking
skills.description: Start or continue a guarded consultation booking flow. Requires user email and selected time before payment.

skills.name: Create payment checkout
skills.description: Create and return a consultation payment checkout link once booking details are collected.

skills.name: Confirm paid booking
skills.description: Confirm the booking only after payment has been verified by the configured provider/webhook.

skills.name: Cancel or reschedule booking
skills.description: Start guarded cancel/reschedule flows for an existing booking; verification is required before calendar mutation.
